title: etcd 3.6：快照還原、revision跳躍與監看快取重建
titleEn: etcd 3.6: restored snapshots, revision jumps and watch-cache rebuilding
subcategoryTitle: 多租戶、復原相依與可用性邊界
subcategoryTitleEn: Multitenancy, recovery dependencies and availability boundaries
summary: 記錄快照revision、客戶端最高已見revision及規劃跳躍量；判斷新revision是否越過已知觀測，並規劃可驗證的快取重新列舉。
summaryEn: Record snapshot revision, highest client-observed revision and the proposed bump. Determine whether the restored revision exceeds known observations, then specify a verifiable cache relist rather than assuming continuity.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「建立快照與客戶端水位」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Inventory snapshot and client watermarks: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 若bump不足，客戶端仍可能等待不存在的歷史延續；若只改revision未重列舉，殘留鍵值可能持續，兩種故障需分開測。
把快照完整性、revision策略及應用重同步列成三個驗收門檻；任何未知的最高觀測revision都要揭露，不能假造確定上界。
控制平面回復較舊快照後，客戶端曾見過的revision比快照高，單看鍵值似乎完整卻可能留下過時快取；本課用本機狀態帳本分析。
optionsEn: An insufficient bump can leave clients waiting for history that no longer continues as expected. Changing revision without relisting can preserve stale keys; test these two failure modes independently.

Treat snapshot integrity, revision strategy and application resynchronization as three separate acceptance gates. Disclose unknown client observation bounds rather than inventing a certain maximum revision.

After a control plane restores an older snapshot, clients may remember revisions beyond the snapshot. Keys can look complete while caches remain stale; this lesson analyzes that condition using local state ledgers.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. After a control plane restores an older snapshot, clients may remember revisions beyond the snapshot. Keys can look complete while caches remain stale; this lesson analyzes that condition using local state ledgers. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Record snapshot revision, highest client-observed revision and the proposed bump. Determine whether the restored revision exceeds known observations, then specify a verifiable cache relist rather than assuming continuity.

stages.title: 建立快照與客戶端水位
stages.description: 控制平面回復較舊快照後，客戶端曾見過的revision比快照高，單看鍵值似乎完整卻可能留下過時快取；本課用本機狀態帳本分析。 記錄快照revision、客戶端最高已見revision及規劃跳躍量；判斷新revision是否越過已知觀測，並規劃可驗證的快取重新列舉。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 給每個客戶端current_revision、cache_keys及watch_state，包含一個已刪除但仍留快取的鍵。重列舉必須替換全集合，不能只把目前鍵追加到舊集合；否則revision更高但陳舊鍵仍在。
stages.descriptionEn: After a control plane restores an older snapshot, clients may remember revisions beyond the snapshot. Keys can look complete while caches remain stale; this lesson analyzes that condition using local state ledgers. Record snapshot revision, highest client-observed revision and the proposed bump. Determine whether the restored revision exceeds known observations, then specify a verifiable cache relist rather than assuming continuity. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Record current_revision, cache_keys and watch_state per client, including a deleted key still present in cache. Relisting must replace the complete set rather than append current keys to the old set. Otherwise revision can increase while the stale deleted key survives, demonstrating why numeric advancement alone is insufficient.
